api/src/services/access_check_entry.py.name: Recheck a decision
api/src/services/access_check_entry.py.description: Re-asks whether a person may still open a record, using their roles as they are now rather than as they were.

api/src/services/access_check_policies.p.name: Data rule decisions
api/src/services/access_check_policies.p.description: Works out which table and file rules apply to the person behind a run, and records each decision that was applied.

api/src/services/access_check_writer.py.name: Permission activity record
api/src/services/access_check_writer.py.description: Writes each permission check down after the answer has gone out, so recording never slows or changes a request.

api/src/services/access_explain.py.name: Permission replays
api/src/services/access_explain.py.description: Re-judges a past permission decision and answers what-if questions about who could do something.

api/src/services/access_list.py.name: Full access list
api/src/services/access_list.py.description: Lists every action the platform offers and the permission each one needs, as the single reference for access.

api/src/services/authorization/__init__..name: Access decisions
api/src/services/authorization/__init__..description: Groups the shared logic that decides what a person may do and then enforces that decision.

api/src/services/authorization/agent_run.name: Agent run permission
api/src/services/authorization/agent_run.description: Confirms, at the moment an agent starts, that the person asking may still run it and spend AI credit.

api/src/services/authorization/authz.py.name: Permission freshness
api/src/services/authorization/authz.py.description: Tracks changes to roles and permissions so the platform knows when a saved decision is out of date.

api/src/services/authorization/callers.p.name: Who is asking
api/src/services/authorization/callers.p.description: Reloads who is asking and what they may do at sensitive moments, instead of trusting details carried from earlier.

api/src/services/authorization/context.p.name: Person's role context
api/src/services/authorization/context.p.description: Gathers a person's home organization and every role they hold, with where each role applies.

api/src/services/authorization/enforce.p.name: Blocking what's not allowed
api/src/services/authorization/enforce.p.description: Stops an action unless the person's current roles allow it, and gives a clear refusal when they do not.

api/src/services/authorization/evaluator.name: The access decision
api/src/services/authorization/evaluator.description: The single rule that answers whether a person may perform a given action on a given record.

api/src/services/authorization/execution.name: Run history visibility
api/src/services/authorization/execution.description: Decides whose run history a person may see, how much detail they get and which runs they may cancel.

api/src/services/authorization/explain.p.name: Why access was allowed
api/src/services/authorization/explain.p.description: Explains step by step why a person or workflow could reach something, and reaches the same answer when checking.

api/src/services/authorization/impersona.name: Acting as another person
api/src/services/authorization/impersona.description: Checks whether a run may act as another person, without ever widening what the original person may do.

api/src/services/authorization/legacy_st.name: Old sign-in usage
api/src/services/authorization/legacy_st.description: Reports which running work still uses the older sign-in format, so it can be retired safely.

api/src/services/authorization/privilege.name: Sensitive role changes
api/src/services/authorization/privilege.description: Flags the roles that carry extra power, and requires the strongest permission to hand them out.

api/src/services/authorization/reach.py.name: Organization reach
api/src/services/authorization/reach.py.description: Works out which organizations an action covers, so lists and their totals only include what the person may see.

api/src/services/authorization/report_sc.name: Report visibility
api/src/services/authorization/report_sc.description: Narrows a report to the organizations the person asking is allowed to see.

api/src/services/authorization/runtime_a.name: Background work sign-in
api/src/services/authorization/runtime_a.description: Turns a background task's sign-in pass into a checked identity, without trusting what that pass claims about itself.

api/src/services/authorization/runtime.p.name: Background work authority
api/src/services/authorization/runtime.p.description: Looks up from current records what a long-running task may do, rather than trusting what it was issued.

api/src/services/authorization/tokens.py.name: Sign-in passes
api/src/services/authorization/tokens.py.description: Creates and checks the signed passes that say who a person is, which roles they hold and what they may do.

api/src/services/cross_org_validation.py.name: Cross-organization references
api/src/services/cross_org_validation.py.description: Stops a record in one organization from pointing at another organization's workflow.

api/src/services/decorator_property_serv.name: Workflow setting editor
api/src/services/decorator_property_serv.description: Reads and updates the settings written above workflow code, and adds a stable identifier where one is missing.

api/src/services/identities.py.name: Named accounts for runs
api/src/services/identities.py.description: Manages the named accounts a workflow can run as, so automated work carries its own limited permissions.

api/src/services/mfa_service.py.name: Two-factor sign-in
api/src/services/mfa_service.py.description: Sets up and checks the second sign-in step, an authenticator code, and manages backup recovery codes.

api/src/services/passkey_service.py.name: Passkey sign-in
api/src/services/passkey_service.py.description: Registers a device's fingerprint or face sign-in and uses it to sign people in without typing a password.

api/src/services/permission_catalog.py.name: Permission list
api/src/services/permission_catalog.py.description: Lists every permission the platform uses, grouped by area, and says where each one is checked.

api/src/services/policy_rule_service.py.name: Data access rules
api/src/services/policy_rule_service.py.description: Manages the reusable rules that decide who may read or change particular tables and files.

api/src/services/recommended_access.py.name: Suggested extra access
api/src/services/recommended_access.py.description: Suggests access a workflow's account needed but lacked, based on what its recent runs were refused.

api/src/services/required_instructions.p.name: Assistant house rules
api/src/services/required_instructions.p.description: Stores the house instructions an AI assistant follows, mixing the platform's built-in guidance with a customer's own.

api/src/services/role_permissions.py.name: Role permissions editor
api/src/services/role_permissions.py.description: Reads and replaces what a role may do, keeping the permission names valid and in the approved list.

api/src/services/service_access.py.name: Service visibility
api/src/services/service_access.py.description: Hides long-running service definitions from people who are not allowed to see them.

api/src/services/service_claim.py.name: Long-running services
api/src/services/service_claim.py.description: Picks up long-running services that should be running, watches each attempt and restarts it by its own rules.

api/src/services/user_access_map.py.name: Person's access summary
api/src/services/user_access_map.py.description: Shows everything one person may do and in which organizations, for their profile page.

api/src/services/user_invite_service.py.name: User invitations
api/src/services/user_invite_service.py.description: Creates, reissues and cancels single-use invitations, so someone can join with a link that expires.

api/src/services/user_mfa_reset.py.name: Reset someone's sign-in security
api/src/services/user_mfa_reset.py.description: Clears every second factor for a user and signs them out everywhere, for when they lose their phone.

api/src/services/user_provisioning.py.name: New user setup
api/src/services/user_provisioning.py.description: Creates a person's account the first time they sign in and gives them the right organization and starting role.

api/src/services/user_role_assignments.p.name: Assigning roles
api/src/services/user_role_assignments.p.description: Gives a person their base role and any extra roles, and checks where each one is allowed to apply.
